title: Sort the words of a file
summary: A .txt file and its number of words: check the arguments, load the words, bubble-sort them.
hints: Check things in this order: argument count, the `.txt` ending (`strrchr(name, '.')`), the number, then `fopen`. Each failure has its own message and status.
Load the words with `fscanf(f, "%31s", words[i])` into a block of `n * 32` bytes from `calloc`, and sort with two nested loops, swapping with `strcpy` when `strcmp(a, b) > 0`.
